incidents_catalogued.title: Uncached Pretrained Backbone Handled via Non-Download Governance Rule
incidents_catalogued.claimed_value: Expected pretrained weight file resnet18-f37072fd.pth to be hashed locally.
incidents_catalogued.machine_truth: File is not present in local torch hub cache directory (C:\Users\Dheeraj\.cache\torch\hub\checkpoints). Under strict task governance, zero network downloads are permitted merely to satisfy documentation. As instructed by protocol, PRETRAINED_FILE_HASH is explicitly recorded as 'NOT_LOCALLY_VERIFIED' with precise rationale.
incidents_catalogued.root_cause: Pretrained weights are downloaded dynamically by torchvision if requested, but local offline execution correctly avoids downloading when pretrained=False.
incidents_catalogued.remediation: Documented PRETRAINED_FILE_HASH = 'NOT_LOCALLY_VERIFIED' in audit and report; initial model state artifact data/ops02/initial_model_state.pt is locally verified with SHA256 4BB233DB629E44DE12E41F11809024B7A5BDA4DBCFB19D13752295973117E45C.

incidents_catalogued.title: Dual Serialization Clarification for Canonical Weight Vectors
incidents_catalogued.location: C22-A.1 vs C22-A.2 weight vector hashing specifications
incidents_catalogued.claimed_value: Python json.dumps produces different SHA256 depending on whitespace delimiters: default with spaces produces DBCDF612... (control) and 5587B0DF... (treatment), while compact UTF-8 with separators=(',', ':') produces 48B6F027... (control) and 42F09924... (treatment).
incidents_catalogued.machine_truth: Both representations represent the identical 12-element decimal list and load to identical torch.float32 tensors. However, cryptographic hashes of text representations differ by whitespace.
incidents_catalogued.root_cause: Default Python json.dumps() introduces space after comma, whereas canonical JSON serialization specifications often require compact representation (no whitespace).
incidents_catalogued.remediation: Explicitly catalogued and verified BOTH hashes in the preflight audit (ops02_c22a2_zero_step_preflight_v1.json), eliminating ambiguity across all future tools.

remediation_summary: Zero blocking issues. All zero-step preflight execution steps succeeded with bitwise and numerical parity. Zero training updates, zero backward passes, zero optimizer steps, zero HOLDOUT access, zero Part-III access.
